meta.title: Korean to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Korean to English by voice or text: speak or paste Hangul, read and hear the English at once, reply back in Korean. Free, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or paste Korean and get the English meaning in seconds, spoken or written. Reply in English and it goes back in Korean.

hero.title: Korean to English translator
hero.description: Korean puts the verb last and marks who is speaking to whom in the ending, so half a sentence tells you nothing. Record or paste it and read the English, then reply in English and send it back in Korean.
hero.mockToPhrase: Do you happen to speak English?

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Korean into English.

items.q: Do I need a Korean keyboard?
items.a: No. Speak the sentence into the mic or paste the Hangul you were sent — nothing has to be typed by you.
Yes. Record it and the English appears a couple of seconds after the person stops speaking.

items.q: Does it keep polite and casual speech apart?
items.a: The honorific level of the sentence is carried into the English, so a polite question does not come out sounding curt.
Yes, your answer is translated into Korean in the same conversation and can be played aloud.
Yes, one history per language pair. It stays saved, and you can clear it anytime with the trash button above the chat.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.
